items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ross said he’d take me to Billy Berg’s

ctx.x: Maybe so. So I gave it to Jim, and I said, “Jim, I think this is for you.” He glanced at the letter and said, “That’s pretty funny.” Then I told him the story that my mother had said, “he’s something like a president.” He said, “She may be right. You may be executive vice president one day,” which I never was. We got to talking about Erroll Garner. I want to back up to still one other thing, which was my first experience in hearing Charlie Parker, which possibly was the second, because Marshall Stearns and I…
He really was as happy as he . . .
